verified_key_information_units.information: Loss explanation and outlook: Management characterizes the reporting year's loss as temporary and not impacting long-term stability; focuses on strategic market niches for wireless data transmission products and specialized solutions.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (zaudējumu situācijas vērtējums un nākotnes plāni)

candidate_sentences.text: Management considers the losses temporary, but remains cautious and has made no specific forecasts for future sales or financial results.

verified_key_information_units.information: Proposal to cover loss: Board of Directors proposes to cover the reporting year's loss from retained earnings of previous years.
